name: Snowdonia in a day
description_md:
Snowdonia in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The route covers 13.7 km of walking between stops and features 5 sightseeing stops.

The day is anchored in Snowdonia in GB. The full day takes about 8.0 hours. This duration includes visit time at each stop.
